_evidence: 0x00536e63 (compose after list_00829278): every link value v is mapped to a record by 'sub v,[0x829710]; jl sentinel; and 0x1fff; shl 4; add [0x829278]' (any v lands in the 0x2000-record, 128 KiB table or on the static sentinel record 0x829700). When the first record's link (ebx) maps to the sentinel, 'mov ecx,[ebx+4]; cmp ecx,-2; je' reads the sentinel's dword +4 (0x829704), which kept its image value. It is drawn here from -2 (the terminator, often) and link values that map below the base (negative), to record 0, small records, the last record and a wrapped one, so both the -2 exit and the 'cmp ecx,esi' comparison occur. Any value maps to valid memory.
